tldr: Stock sync is close to done end to end. A PR for hybrid ack handling on kit syncs that might overrun the pub/sub deadline is in review, and the Shopify and SFTP stock sync types work comes next.
Go-live picture before Christmas: Flir is aiming for early next week, Edom UK and Joe Loves are very unlikely, and Eccentric Molecules was pushed back a week because of the dual Shopify ticket.
Eccentric Molecules go/no-go on the two-store work is to be decided Wednesday. The backout plan is a full rollback, which nobody wants.
CT onboarding is on track on the Fuse side. Files will be staggered MD, then SO, then PO, but config in the Fuse UI waits on GLN numbers and the customer's values.
Tom has four hours today for platform testing. Failures so far are data validity, not platform issues.
decisions: Eccentric Molecules go-live was pushed back by a week, agreed with the projects team.
CT files will be staggered MD first, then SO, then PO, two to three days apart.
The stock sync mapping format (simple or line-level for SFTP) will be discussed offline, not in standup.
Wednesday is when the team decides whether to proceed with the Eccentric Molecules two-store go-live.

Will Eccentric Molecules go ahead with the two-store go-live? It is to be decided Wednesday.
Are smoke tests before the Flir go-live agreed? Jack said this is not fully agreed and left the detail to Tom.
